description: Wrap your text in decorative box-drawing borders — single, double, rounded or star styles.

faqs.a: Single (┌─┐), Double (╔═╗), Rounded (╭─╮) and Star (*) borders.
The box auto-sizes to the longest line, with adjustable padding.

faqs.q: Will the box display correctly everywhere?
faqs.a: The box uses standard Unicode box-drawing characters, which render correctly in terminals, code editors and most chat apps.

howto: Type or paste your text (multiple lines OK).
Choose a border style and padding.
